ns2:section.sectionText: NEUR 520, PQL is a faculty sponsored, post-qual, graduate student course that is student led. Each week, graduate students will present their work from a wide breadth of Neuroscience topics to their peers who will be able to provide feedback in a supportive and constructive environment. Pre-qual students are encouraged to attend, and will be able to sign up to present once all of the post-qual students have signed-up.
